heading: Review, queue, and retry SFTP transfers
summary: Compare folders before copying, track transfers while you browse, and resolve file conflicts without holding up transfers on other connections.
changes: Use the Transfers drawer for progress, error details, and pause, cancel, or retry controls. Comparison transfers appear as a group.
Compare local and remote folders or two remote folders. Select files, expand size and modification details, and stop validation before jobs are queued.
PromeFTP checks for path name collisions and rechecks the selected files against the preview. Files found only at the destination are preserved.
Find folders and recover interrupted work
Edit and reorder path favorites. Reopen the matching SFTP connection to retry a failed file-menu transfer.
notice: Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon. Remote Keep Both requires the server's OpenSSH hard-link extension.
